claims.quote: PCDH19-related epilepsy is a rare X-linked type of epilepsy caused by genomic variants of the Protocadherin 19 (PCDH19) gene.
The genetic analysis identified the two variants c.1006G > A (p.Val336Met) and c.1014C > A (p.Asp338Glu) in the gene PCDH19.

claims.object_text: seizure clusters arising under condition of apyrexia
claims.quote: Our patient was admitted for the first time at the age of 12 months for seizure clusters arising under condition of apyrexia.
The electroencephalography (EEG) showed frontal paroxysmal activity.

claims.object_text: no cognitive impairment or behavior disturbances / persistently normal neurological examination
claims.quote: During the follow-up, the neurological examination was persistently normal with neither cognitive impairment nor behavior disturbances.
The patient was treated with Carbamazepine and Clonazepam achieving the disappearance of seizures.
